description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Doratiyawa, Mallavapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - (25/5514102)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration, specifically the declaration of title determination for a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:49) in Doratiyava. It involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement exercising powers under the Registration of Title Act to formally register land ownership, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
